# Council of AI (CSOAI)

> Public measurement service for AI behaviour — measurement, not certification.

Council of AI (CSOAI) is the public measurement service operated by CSOAI Ltd, a company incorporated in England and Wales on 2 January 2026 (Companies House 16939677), founded by Nicholas Templeman. It runs AI systems and digital rails against published instruments, grades deterministically where the method permits, publishes signed evidence and corrections, and keeps unmeasured or uncheckable states visible. Verification is free. CSOAI measures; it does not certify, accredit, issue legal-compliance determinations, sell a rank, or take money from anything it ranks.

## Key facts
- 23 axes measured; model comparisons published with explicit TIE/UNTESTED determinations; "TIE is TIE".
- Signed measurement cards (GSPC): Ed25519-signed cards, Merkle root, public verification.
- Machine-readable catalogue: https://councilof.ai/catalog.json — live board: https://councilof.ai/api/gspc
- Live counts belong to GET councilof.ai/api/gspc, never to any static page or badge.

## Pages
- [Home](https://councilof.ai): the measurement service and its published methods
- [Free verification](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/): check a supported signed measurement card
- [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/): published instruments and grading methods
- [Machine catalogue](https://councilof.ai/catalog.json): machine-readable service catalogue
- [GSPC board API](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc): live board state

## How to cite
Cite as "Council of AI (CSOAI), AI-behaviour measurement service" with the specific signed card or board API response and its date. Do not represent any measurement as certification, accreditation or legal compliance.

## Related (CSOAI estate)
- [GSPC Board repository](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/gspc-board): the public evidence layer
- [Sovereign wiki](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/sovereign-wiki): source catalogue
